name: Miyamura Chiaki
source: Masshigura self proclaimed owner. When attending to customers, she would always pretend to be well behaved. When praised she becomes very happy, but because she isn't straightforward, there is always a tone of arrogance in her answers. She is sensitive about her pettanko chest and is envious towards her friend Yuuna's busty figure, so she drinks milk everyday and do gymnastics. Thinks that cat ears and tail is very cute, and that they're a perfect match for herself who is also very cute.
